archives.title: Mary Shepherd Slusser papers
archives.note: Nepal series: correspondence, subject file, maps and plans, writings; focused on her Nepal Mandala research. Access by appointment. Objects she donated are held in NMNH Anthropology (search 'Slusser' in Objects).
archives.open: Catalogue record CC0; digital content usage conditions may apply

archives.holder: Smithsonian — National Museum of Asian Art Archives
archives.title: Mary Slusser Collection
archives.note: Personal and professional files, research files, travel documents, prints, slides, negatives.

archives.title: Todd Lewis films of Samyak and Panchare Festivals in Nepal
archives.note: Samyak festival and the 12-yearly Panchare festival, Asan Tol, Kathmandu.

archives.title: National Anthropological Film Center films of Nepal
Todd Lewis collection of photographs of Nepal
archives.extent: 23 glass negatives, 67 copy negatives, 50 nitrate negatives
archives.note: Many copied from originals held by Nepalese individuals; religious sites, artwork, ceremonies.

archives.title: John C. Cool and Dor Bahadur Bista field reports (MS 4831, 4832, 4833)
archives.note: Gurung household in Rapti Valley; Khumbu and Pharak (Solukhumbu); Tharu peasant economy.

archives.title: John T. Hitchcock papers
archives.note: Field notes, manuscripts, maps, photographs from 1960s research in India and Nepal.

archives.holder: Smithsonian — National Museum of Asian Art Archives
archives.title: Stephen Eckerd Collection of Photographs
archives.note: Photographs and postcards of Nepal; digital content available.

archives.title: Nepal Tiger Project Oral History Interviews
Hodgson Collection
archives.extent: 972 documents, c. 15,300 folios plus scrolls, notebooks, letters
archives.note: Deposited at the India Office Library in 1864. Online catalogue launched 2011. Further Hodgson papers at the Royal Asiatic Society, Zoological Society of London and Bodleian Library.

archives.title: Sanskrit Manuscripts (Wright and Bendall collections from Nepal)
archives.note: Original palm-leaf manuscripts procured in Nepal by Daniel Wright; Add.864 is an illustrated 16th-c. Nepalese accordion book. Bendall's 1883 catalogue is freely available.
archives.open: Digitised images on Cambridge Digital Library (check per-item rights)

archives.holder: University of Hamburg / National Archives of Nepal / Berlin State Library
archives.title: Nepal-German Manuscript Preservation Project (NGMPP) and Cataloguing Project (NGMCP)
archives.note: Originals mostly remain in Nepal; microfilms at National Archives, Kathmandu; X-series (c. 700 MSS) held in Berlin, digitised and handed to Nepal in 2024. Useful for identifying texts that later left Nepal.

archives.title: MS Indic delta 41 — Nihsvasatattvasamhita (copy)
archives.note: Copied in Kathmandu by Bauddhaesevita Vajracarya for Dr Paira Mall from a palm-leaf original. Wellcome's Indic manuscripts may be catalogued by language rather than place, so a 'Nepal' keyword search likely undercounts.

archives.holder: Musée national des arts asiatiques – Guimet
archives.title: Hodgson fonds (deposited by the Institut de France)
archives.note: Also the Lionel Fournier donation (1989), with 16 Nepalese works including 13th-c. painted scrolls.

institutions.name: Art Institute of Chicago
institutions.licence: Data CC0; public-domain images via IIIF
institutions.notes: 84 records with a Nepalese place of origin (Nepal or Kathmandu Valley).

institutions.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
institutions.licence: Open Access CC0 for public-domain works
institutions.notes: Search index returned 237 IDs; 10 object records now return 404 (logged, reason unknown).

institutions.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
institutions.notes: 374 of the records are folios of a single Gandavyuha-sutra manuscript. Provenance field included.

institutions.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
institutions.notes: Object history (acquisition) text included where present.

institutions.name: Wellcome Collection
institutions.licence: Varies per image (Public Domain Mark, CC BY, etc.)
institutions.notes: Keyword match; weak matches are flagged and hidden by default.

institutions.name: Harvard Art Museums
institutions.licence: Check Harvard API terms before reuse
institutions.notes: Records matched by place (Nepal) and culture (Nepalese) IDs. Mostly manuscripts, largely the Philip Hofer gift; also sculpture and 1980s photographs of Nepal.

institutions.name: Smithsonian Institution
institutions.access: Open Access dataset on AWS (public S3 bucket, no key); SOVA site blocks scripts
institutions.notes: Harvested units: Asian Art (objects and archives), Anthropological Archives, Film Archives, Natural History anthropology, Folklife, Cooper Hewitt. Only 2 strong Asian Art object records, so its Nepalese holdings are probably under-represented; search asia.si.edu directly. Natural History holds objects donated by Mary Slusser (e.g. accession 271950, 1967).

institutions.name: British Museum
institutions.access: No public API found; collection site blocks scripts
institutions.notes: HAR indexes 61 images of Nepalese sculpture. National museum deaccession restrictions apply.

institutions.name: Musée Guimet
institutions.notes: Nepalese collection described as about 80 pieces. Holds two stelae documented as stolen.

institutions.name: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
institutions.access: Collection site did not respond to scripted queries
institutions.notes: Nepalese holdings under activist scrutiny; no repatriations reported as of March 2025.

institutions.name: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
institutions.access: Collection site did not respond to scripted queries
institutions.notes: No Nepal-specific repatriation found in searches. Unchecked, not cleared.

institutions.name: Asian Art Museum, San Francisco
institutions.access: Collection site did not respond to scripted queries
institutions.notes: Repatriation news concerns Thailand; no Nepal-specific claim found.

institutions.name: Rubin Museum of Himalayan Art
institutions.access: Galleries closed Oct 2024; now a 'museum without walls'
institutions.notes: Nearly 4,000 Himalayan objects. Publishes a deaccession list with HAR numbers.

institutions.name: Himalayan Art Resources
institutions.access: Image database indexed by holder, auction house and photo archive
institutions.notes: The auction-house and photographic-archive indexes are the most useful for provenance matching.

institutions.name: Nepal Heritage Recovery Campaign (NHRC)
institutions.access: Website object pages (read by hand; no API reachable)
institutions.licence: Reference only — link to NHRC pages
institutions.notes: Kathmandu-based campaign working with the Department of Archaeology. Lists objects as Repatriation, Recovery in Progress and Found Heritage, with holder, accession number and original site. Statuses as shown on 16 Sep 2026; category pages may have further pages not read.

institutions.name: Ashmolean Museum, Oxford
institutions.notes: Holds a 7th–8th-c. Avalokiteshvara that NHRC identifies as stolen from Ta Baha, Kathmandu.

repatriation.object: Uma-Maheshvara stone relief
repatriation.detail: Surfaced with a Wiesbaden dealer in 1995; formally returned 28 August 2000.

repatriation.holder: Dallas Museum of Art (on loan from a collector)
repatriation.object: Lakshmi-Narayana stele
repatriation.detail: Sold at Sotheby's 1990; returned with the FBI in March 2021; reinstalled at its temple December 2021.

repatriation.object: Uma-Maheshvara, 10th c. (1980.231)
repatriation.detail: Handed to the Nepal Embassy in Washington DC. Credit line: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Edwin F. Ullman.

repatriation.object: Garland-Bearing Apsaras, 14th c. (HAR 65290)
repatriation.detail: Rubin deaccession list gives 2021; Rubin later co-funded the Itumbaha Museum (opened July 2023).

repatriation.object: Upper section of a torana, 17th c. (C2010.14; HAR 65866)
repatriation.detail: Memorandum of understanding signed with Nepal's consul general.

repatriation.object: Carved wooden torana, 16th c.; stone kneeling devotee, 18th c.
repatriation.detail: Handed to Nepal's Ambassador in London on 18 March 2022 after Lost Arts of Nepal spotted them online.

repatriation.object: Shiva in Himalayan Abode with Ascetics, 10th c. (1995.570.5); salabhanjika temple strut, 13th c.
repatriation.detail: Returned after internal provenance research. NHRC gives its origin as Kankeshwori Temple; credit line Gift of Evelyn Kossak. No longer in the Met's API (checked 16 Sep 2026).

repatriation.object: Vishnu Flanked by Lakshmi and Garuda, 11th c.; wooden temple strut, 13th c.
repatriation.detail: Return announced October 2023. Possible overlap with the 2022 strut and ICOM's reference to a pillar — verify.

repatriation.holder: Rubin Museum and Dallas Museum of Art
repatriation.object: Pair of gilt-bronze Bhairava masks, 16th c.
repatriation.detail: Returned via the Manhattan DA; shown in Kathmandu on 31 January 2024. The Rubin list's 'Hatha Dya as Bhairava' (deaccessioned 2023) may be one of these — unconfirmed.

repatriation.object: Uma-Maheshvara, 16th c.
repatriation.detail: Passed to the Manhattan DA; reinstalled at its temple on 15 February 2024.

repatriation.object: Buddhist Goddess Tara, late 9th – early 10th c. (2015.16.3)
repatriation.origin: Bir Bhadreshwor Mahadev Temple, Golmadhi Tol, Bhaktapur
repatriation.detail: Identified by the gallery's provenance research in 2021 and transferred to Nepal's Department of Archaeology.

repatriation.object: 12th-c. sculpture
repatriation.detail: Announced March 2025. Possibly the Muchalinda Buddha (see that entry) — unconfirmed. Lost Arts of Nepal said this was one return against eight claims; NHRC's site lists eight AIC objects in total (two returned, six identified as stolen).

repatriation.holder: Manhattan DA (incl. Univ. of Michigan Museum of Art; Ellsworth estate)
repatriation.object: 20 antiquities incl. 9th-c. black stone Buddha; goddess figure; 15th-c. painting
repatriation.origin: Bungamati stupa (Buddha); Vishnu Devi Temple complex, Kathmandu (goddess)
repatriation.detail: Several linked to Subhash Kapoor investigations; announced March 2025.

repatriation.holder: Art Gallery of New South Wales, Australia
repatriation.object: Roof strut with shalabhanjika, 13th c. (33.2000.a-b)
repatriation.detail: Returned May 2023; displayed at the National Museum, Kathmandu. Credit line: Bequest of Alex Biancardi 2000.

repatriation.object: Two temple artefacts
repatriation.detail: Voluntary return reported. NHRC separately lists a 17th-c. grey stone Kneeling Devotee from Wotu Tole, Kathmandu at Barakat's UK gallery (F.048_BAR_02) as Found Heritage; its current status is unclear and it may relate to this return or to the 2022 Metropolitan Police return.

repatriation.object: Vishnu with Lakshmi and Garuda, 12th c.
repatriation.detail: Bought on the London market 1986; withdrawn from display; reported still in France in 2022.

repatriation.object: Uma-Maheshvara (sources give 11th, 12th or 13th c.)
repatriation.detail: Documented by Lain Singh Bangdel; reported still in France in 2022. NHRC lists it under Recovery in Progress and dates it 12th c.

repatriation.object: Necklace Inscribed with the Name of King Pratapamalladeva (Taleju Bhawani), 17th c. (2010.575)
repatriation.detail: ICOM (2024) described it as a loan from the Alsdorf Foundation since 1976; the AIC API credit line now reads 'Gift of the Alsdorf Foundation' (checked 16 Sep 2026). NHRC lists it as Found Heritage, from the Taleju Bhawani temple, Kathmandu.

repatriation.object: Buddha Sheltered by the Serpent King Muchalinda (2014.1030)
repatriation.detail: NHRC lists it as repatriated, and accession 2014.1030 no longer appears in the AIC API (checked 16 Sep 2026). It may be the 12th-c. sculpture from Guita Bahi, Patan, whose return AIC announced in March 2025, but I have not found a source that says so explicitly.

repatriation.holder: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
repatriation.object: 12th-c. copper Buddha with scenes from his life
repatriation.detail: Activists and scholars argue it should be returned; no LACMA repatriations reported as of March 2025.

repatriation.object: 16th-c. Malla-era paubha
repatriation.detail: Single web source; not confirmed elsewhere.

repatriation.object: Five gilt metal deities from the Mulchok torana, Taleju temple, Patan
repatriation.detail: Activists stopped the sale within 24 hours of listing; NHRC lists the figures as Found Heritage (location of the objects since then not stated).

repatriation.object: Chaturmukhi Shivalinga, 13th c.
repatriation.detail: NHRC: handed to the Nepal Embassy in Washington DC in April.

repatriation.object: Seated Ganesh, 9th–10th c., brass
repatriation.detail: NHRC case 3: seized from Kapoor's gallery; now at the National Museum, Chhauni.

repatriation.object: Seated Buddha in Bhumisparsha Mudra, 14th c., brass
repatriation.detail: NHRC case 3: seized from Kapoor's gallery; now at the National Museum, Chhauni.

repatriation.object: Wooden strut depicting an apsara, 13th c.
repatriation.detail: NHRC case 3: seized from Kapoor's gallery; now at the National Museum, Chhauni.

repatriation.object: God Vishnu with Goddess Lakshmi and His Mount, Garuda (2014.1026); NHRC: Sridhara Vishnu
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. Still in the AIC collection (checked 16 Sep 2026). Gift of Marilynn B. Alsdorf.

repatriation.object: Bodhisattva Amoghapasha Lokeshvara, wood (2014.1032)
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. Still in the AIC collection (checked 16 Sep 2026). Gift of Marilynn B. Alsdorf.

repatriation.object: Garuda Standing with Hands in Anjalimudra, stone (2006.183)
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. Still in the AIC collection (checked 16 Sep 2026). Gift of Marilynn B. Alsdorf.

repatriation.object: Goddess Tara with Hand in Gesture of Reassurance, wood (2014.1035)
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. Still in the AIC collection (checked 16 Sep 2026). Gift of Marilynn B. Alsdorf.

repatriation.object: Accession 2014.1021 — NHRC: Dancing Bhairav, stone, c. 1300; AIC title: Jvaradeva, God of Fever
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. The accession number matches but the titles differ; check which identification is correct before citing. Still in the AIC collection (checked 16 Sep 2026).

repatriation.object: Avalokiteshvara, 7th–8th c., stone
repatriation.origin: Ta Baha monastery, Lagan Tole, Kathmandu (per NHRC)
repatriation.detail: NHRC Found Heritage. No accession number given; not yet checked against the Ashmolean's catalogue.

repatriation.object: Ganesh stele, 17th c., stone
repatriation.detail: NHRC: offered for sale by the gallery. Current whereabouts not stated.
